  retries: 3
  timeout: 30s

    <<: *defaults
    image: "nginx:1.25"
    ports: ["80:80", '443:443']

      - EMPTY=

      sh -c "echo hi &&
      exec nginx"
    healthcheck: |
      curl -f http://localhost/ || exit 1
  db: { image: postgres, ports: [5432] }

  - name: a
    value: 1
  - name: b
    value: ~

  line two"

? complex key
